name: tensorcad
description: Schematic capture for neural network architectures

scripts._comment_test: 90s per test, not because any test is slow but because the CLI suite spawns a process per case and each loads a 7.7 MB engine; under full-suite load one of them has crossed 30s three times, always passing alone. A ceiling still catches a hang.
scripts.test: bun run build:wasm && bun test --timeout 90000 packages
scripts.test:go: cd packages/core-go && go test ./... && cd ../../desktop && go test ./...
scripts.test:all: bun run typecheck && bun run boundary && bun run text && bun run test && bun run test:browser && bun run test:go
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:engine && bun run typecheck:cli && bun run typecheck:mcp && bun run typecheck:ui
